plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official Salem College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (current edition, catoid=34), Chemistry Major (BA) program page (poid=890). Salem College publishes major requirements but no official semester sequence for this program (its Print Degree Planner is a blank worksheet), so the plan is collected in requirements_only form as a single block. The recorded total is the major requirement only; the full degree requirements, including the Salem Impact core (published separately in the same catalog), are not itemized here. Per-course credits are the Hour(s) values printed on each course's own official course detail page in the same catalog; the program page itself prints no per-course credits. Courses titled 'with Lab' carry separate lab corequisites in the catalog, each printed at 0 Hour(s); the 0-credit labs are disclosed in the notes and are not placed as separate courses. Catalog anomaly, transcribed as printed and not corrected: CHEM 120's detail page prints its prerequisite as 'XXX 111', and CHEM 110L's detail prints 'Lab component of XXX 111'; no such course exists in the catalog, so CHEM 120 carries no recorded prerequisite. The 0-credit lab corequisites in this plan are: BIOL 100L, BIOL 101L, BIOL 310L, CHEM 110L, CHEM 120L, CHEM 201L, CHEM 202L, PHYS 210L and PHYS 220L (Biochemistry/Chemistry subset as applicable), plus BIOL 205L when BIOL 205 is the statistics choice. The catalog states the major requires a minimum of 39 semester hours. Counting each cross-listed pair once (CHEM 311 is cross-listed with BCHM 311; CHEM 390 is cross-listed with BCHM 390; both pairs are printed as separate lines on the program page but are single courses), the named required courses sum to 33. The catalog's elective heading ('select a minimum 3 semester hours of CHEM electives, which can include BCHM 305 and BCHM 306') is open-ended; at its printed 3-hour minimum the itemized total is 36, 3 short of the stated 39. The stated 39 minimum is reached only at 6 elective hours, so the elective block is exercised as two 3-credit choice slots, disclosed here; the recorded total (39) is the catalog's stated minimum. Residency as printed: at least three of the classes must be taken at Salem. The catalog's advanced-placement paragraph prints 'XXX 111CHEM 110' (no space) where CHEM 110 credit is described; transcribed as printed in this disclosure and not corrected. Further catalog anomalies disclosed, not corrected: BCHM 306 is printed at 3 Hour(s) while its description says 'Four hours of lecture'; BCHM 311's detail page prints its cross-listing with CHEM 311 while CHEM 311's prints none; BCHM 390's detail page carries a Writing Intensive general-education line that CHEM 390's does not.

courses.title: Chemistry Elective
courses.choice_note: Part of the catalog's CHEM electives block ('select a minimum 3 semester hours of CHEM electives, which can include' BCHM 305 and BCHM 306). The block is open-ended, so the two named courses are examples carried as options, not an exhaustive list. This block is exercised at 6 hours total across two slots so the plan reaches the catalog's stated 39-hour major minimum; see the plan notes.
